description: Source code for the ue_cell_grid_allocator class, managing resource allocation for uplink and downlink in a 5G NR scheduler, including grant setup, resource calculation, and post-processing.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator
classes.description: Manages resource allocation for UEs in a 5G NR scheduler, including downlink/uplink grants, resource calculation, and post-processing.

classes.name: dl_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Helper class to set PDSCH parameters for new downlink grants.

classes.name: ul_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Helper class to set PUSCH parameters for new uplink grants.

methods.name: calculate_dl_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates downlink MCS and TBS based on resource allocation, CSI-RS presence, and cell configuration.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch
methods.description: Allocates downlink PDCCH for a UE, returning PDCCH info or an error status.

methods.name: alloc_uci
methods.description: Allocates UCI (HARQ ACK, CSI, etc.) for a UE in a given search space.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant
methods.description: Sets up a downlink grant for a new transmission, returning a builder or error.

methods.name: setup_dl_grant_builder
methods.description: Configures a downlink grant, including resource and HARQ setup.

methods.name: set_pdsch_params
methods.description: Transfers PDSCH parameters to the grant, marking resources and configuring DCI.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant (retransmission)
methods.description: Allocates resources for a retransmission downlink grant.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant
methods.description: Sets up an uplink grant for a new transmission.

methods.name: setup_ul_grant_builder
methods.description: Configures an uplink grant, including resource and HARQ setup.

methods.name: set_pusch_params
methods.description: Transfers PUSCH parameters to the grant, marking resources and configuring DCI.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Cleans up cancelled grants and updates PUCCH power control results.

methods.name: post_process_pucch_pw_ctrl_results
methods.description: Updates PUCCH power control states based on scheduled grants.

methods.name: dl_newtx_grant_builder::set_pdsch_params
methods.description: Transfers PDSCH parameters from builder to parent grant.

methods.name: ul_newtx_grant_builder::set_pusch_params
methods.description: Transfers PUSCH parameters from builder to parent grant.
